verdict.rationale: Inngest ships an official MCP server so natural-language coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) can inspect and operate the platform, and its CLI is documented as agent-accessible for run inspection/invocation — enabling NL-driven operation indirectly through third-party AI clients rather than a built-in NL command interface. Missing for 10: a first-party chat/NL interface within Inngest itself, and independent hands-on evidence of the MCP server actually being used to operate Inngest via natural language.
